free_tier.stated: Startup plan: up to 9 000 emails per month, 300 emails per day, 0 EUR per month, on a shared IP with 1 day of log retention
free_tier.notes: On the Startup plan the sender can only send the messages the plan offers, so sending stops at the plan volume instead of incurring an overage charge. Unused messages do not transfer to the next billing month. The Email RESTful API, SMTP relay, email templates and basic analytics are included. Mail goes out from a shared IP. The card requirement for the Startup plan is not stated on the public pricing pages; the FAQ describes a separate sales approved trial that needs no card but forbids production sends.

per_object_cap.stated: 15 MB maximum size of an email with an attachment; oversized mail is rejected
per_object_cap.notes: Oversized mail is rejected with SMTP error 552 or API error 413. The figure is a message weight in MB, so it is not a single binary object cap.

retention.stated: 1 day of log retention on the Startup plan
retention.notes: The plan comparison lists 1 day for Startup, 7 days for Essential and 15 days for Pro and Enterprise.

interface_detail: The Email RESTful API follows JSONAPI and is described by an OpenAPI 3.0.2 file. Cloud SMTP relay is at smtp-relay.emaillabs.net.pl on ports 587, 2525 and 25 with STARTTLS, or 465 with SSL. The interface vocabulary has no SMTP term.
tooling: any SMTP client, or the REST API using the Application-Key and Authorization keys generated in the panel under Account, Settings, API
chaining: a 300 per day relay with a 9 000 per month ceiling and a 15 MB message weight cap; the monthly volume does not carry over and the 1 day log retention needs prompt failure checking

limits.value: 300 emails per day and 9 000 emails per month on the Startup plan; mail beyond the plan volume is not delivered
15 MB maximum email size with an attachment; oversized mail is rejected
1 day of log retention on the Startup plan

the account is verified by the EmailLabs team at registration; a sandbox domain is assigned for testing, and production sending needs a plan and an authorized sending domain with SPF, DKIM and DMARC records

limits_note: counts of messages and a message weight, not shaped rates; the daily and monthly ceilings are the volume counts that bind on the free plan.
binding_note: the 300 per day and 9 000 per month ceiling on Startup is the first hard ceiling at sustained sending scale, since mail beyond the plan volume is not delivered; a one time team verification and domain authorization gate production sending before that ceiling applies.

identity_cost.detail: Registration asks for an email address, a login and a password of at least 12 characters with an uppercase letter, a lowercase letter, a number and a special character, and acceptance of the terms. The address must be activated by a link in a message. Phone number verification by SMS code is a mandatory step and also activates two factor authentication. A three step survey then asks for company details including Tax ID and website address, the services of interest, and the size and source of the contact database. The account is then sent for verification by the EmailLabs team. Card requirement for the free Startup plan is unverified: not stated on the public pricing pages. The separate sales approved trial needs no card but uses test addresses only and forbids production sends.

reliability_note: Startup mail stops at the plan volume rather than incurring an overage charge, unused messages do not carry to the next month, oversized mail is rejected, and 1 day of log retention leaves little time to inspect failures
confidence_note: all values come from first party pricing, plan comparison, documentation and onboarding pages captured and quoted on 2026-11-19; no probe was run, so delivery and the account gate were not measured
